engine_thread_timing_scope: Latest completed UE viewport frame; CPU times exclude idle; threads overlap; not GPU duration; zero may mean unavailable with nullrhi
timing_scope: Custom controller, perception subsystem, squad subsystem; excludes UE movement, animation, rendering and HUD
cover_diagnostics_scope: Whole match including pre-save time; ai_* are AI unit-frames in Follow; request_* are per RequestCoverAction call by furthest stage; peek_* are per rejected peek offset; cancel_* are cover endings
tactical_time_scope: 1Hz squad samples; active delegated AI only; not per-soldier or exact transition timestamps
observation_scope: 5Hz sampling; person-seconds, memory/shared separated; headless frame timing is not rendered performance

leader_survival.scope: Unit shots only, by victim team, from experiment start (save/load does not reset); rank 0 = living squad member nearest the shooter

supply_cycle.scope: Trips timed on the tactical clock from HomeSupplyReturn to HomeSupplyResume; emergency aborts are tactical_events.HomeSupplyAbortEmergency; trips begun before a save/load lose their start (HomeSupplyEndWithoutStart); front = living soldiers within 100m 2D of any objective, 5Hz

arrival_scope: End snapshot only, not cumulative order success
